covered_actors: EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies (EUIs)
Data processors and third-party generative AI developers or service providers
implementation_notes: Version 2 of the EDPS Orientations (revising and expanding the 2024 first edition) providing practical advice to EUIs on complying with Regulation (EU) 2018/1725 (EUDPR) across the generative AI lifecycle. Issued solely in the EDPS's capacity as a data protection supervisory authority—not as a market surveillance authority under the EU AI Act—and without prejudice to the AI Act. The guidance emphasizes principle-based compliance rather than prescribing specific technical measures, aligns with EDPB Opinion 28/2024, references forthcoming EDPS AI risk management guidance, and notes that it may be further updated as generative AI technologies evolve.
